verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://developers.kit.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown docs, and the many .md doc URLs show agent-readable page variants. Kit also ships a dedicated Developer Docs MCP server so coding agents can query the live API reference instead of a cached or hallucinated one. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
